units: pixels (x right, y down, full-resolution 1080x1080 image) and seconds; no metric scale

camera.motion: static: phase correlation of background regions vs frame 0 gives shifts < 0.03 px for every frame
camera.view: aerial, looking (nearly) straight down onto a beach; no horizon or vanishing points visible. The ground is roughly fronto-parallel; a slight tilt shows the walker's front/top (walker appears ~45 px long as a standing figure, so the view is not exactly nadir).
camera.duplicate_frame: frame 1 is an exact duplicate of frame 0 (all objects identical); real motion starts between frames 1 and 2

walker.kind: human (man, white T-shirt, grey trousers, brown hair)
walker.distinguish: only person; on the sand at x~356-375, y~367-519, walking toward the bottom of the image (toward the water). Long dark shadow attached at his feet pointing up-right.
walker.reference_point: pelvis_torso_x/y (shirt centroid + constant offset (2.6, 8.8) px; recommended, smooth) or pelvis_x/y (0.48 of head-top..feet span; noisier with leg swing)
walker.motion_px_per_frame: about (0.1, +1.5) px/frame, direction ~86 deg (straight down the image), steady over the whole clip
walker.apparent_size_px: vertical body length (head top to lowest foot) 39-50 px, median 45.5; width 17-24 px; no trend over time (constant depth)

walker_shadow.distinguish: sharp dark silhouette from the walker's feet to the up-right, axis ~151 deg (image coords), length ~100-108 px

bird.distinguish: only flying animal; near-black, crisp; enters at the left edge (x=0, y~360) at frame 0, crosses over the walker's feet/shadow at frames 22-25, flies over the water and leaves at the right edge after frame 67 (partly outside image at frames 0-2 and 67)
bird.reference_point: cx, cy = mask centroid (bbc_x/bbc_y = bbox centre also given)
bird.motion_px_per_frame: ~16-17.5 px/frame in x, +2..+6 px/frame in y (heading wavers between ~7 and ~27 deg below the +x axis in a ~12-frame rhythm)
bird.apparent_size_px: mask main-axis length (≈ wingspan in projection) oscillates with wing beats: 36-63 px. Peaks at frames 5 (57), 31 (58), 54 (63); troughs ~frames 11, 22-24 (36), 47. bbox up to 39x59 px. Minimum (clean frames) 35.9 px at frame 22, maximum 62.8 px at frame 54.

bird_shadow.kind: cast shadow of the bird on the sand
bird_shadow.distinguish: blurry dark-brown bird shape far up-right of the bird (offset ~ +360 px x, -45 px y at frame 0), crosses the walker at frames 6-8, fades out over the water after frame ~36 (37-38 weak)

sand_beach.extent_px: dry sand covers the upper-left; sand x-range at y=380: 0-841, y=490: 0-739, y=600: 56-627, y=700: 171-527; pointed lower tip near (395-430, 720-760) where it blends into shallow water; light curved bands (wet-sand lines) parallel to the shore

water_sea.kind: static (green sea, lower and right part)
water_sea.extent_px: everything below/right of the sand edge; bbox (0,82)-(1079,1079)

rock_cliff.kind: static rocky outcrop with dark rocks at top right of the sand
rock_cliff.extent_px: approx x 500-1000, y 0-215 (dark rock part detected x 702-990, y 0-217); a white/light patch at its top-left around x 520-700, y 0-110

events.what: clip starts; walker already walking; bird entering at left edge
duplicate of frame 0 (no motion between frames 0 and 1)
bird fully inside the image from frame 3 (cut by the left edge in frames 0-2, so its centroid there is biased toward the visible part, i.e. to the right)
bird shadow passes over the walker's shadow / body (merge, occlusion flag)
bird passes directly over the walker's feet / shadow root (image overlap; bird is above, not in contact)
bird shadow reaches the water and fades (last weak detection frame 38)
bird touches right edge (last visible frame); absent from frame 68 on

no_contacts_or_bounces: no impacts/bounces; walker never stops or turns
